decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is occupied.
Condition : 3 - The windows formed in the western elevation shall be double glazed and non opening and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise.

Condition : 4 - Before first occupation of the buildings the loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing No. BAM0805 LO:02 REV A, received 06.03.03 and such spaces shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 5 - The premises shall be used as an office and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class B 1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
description: Change of use of former print works to office use.
